To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) tabular data are better than graphical data, and that (2) a combination of tabular and graphical data is better than either form alone.
the combination of tables and graphs produced the highest comprehension scores, and the tabular form produced the fastest comprehension scores.
the use of tables, in particular, increases the comprehension of the data presented.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an information presentation form which maximizes the comprehension and usability of information for a given task.
the presentation of data and its effects on comprehension and memory.
the design of computer interfaces that present information in a manner that facilitates the user's understanding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
graphical data is more useful for recall and non-recall memory tasks and tabular data is more useful in compare and compare/calculate tasks.
a combination of tables and graphs is more effective than either form alone.
a combination of graphical (graphs) and tabular (tables) data presentation methods is the most effective and efficient way to communicate information to a decision maker.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
graphical and tabular forms are not substitutes for each other but that both can be used to enhance comprehension.
a combination of tables and graphs is better for comprehension than either alone.
the combination of graphical and numerical data presentation is more useful than either form used alone, and is especially effective when used with a memory task.
The main takeaway from our work is that
graphical and tabular information can be combined for better comprehension.
the combination of graphical and textual forms of data presentation can be a powerful means for communicating information.
graphical data presentation should be used to supplement, but not replace, tabular data presentation.
